experiments.procedure: Restore initial SF100 state; execute the complete frozen mixed validation stream with the official driver; compare all reads and verify update effects
experiments.passEvidence: All 29 classes covered; no wrong, missing or uncommitted operations; import and post-run reconciliation

experiments.procedure: Same artifact on both sides; freeze randomized paired order, cache/restore and full comparison family; repeat complete experiments across time periods
experiments.passEvidence: False-positive counts, denominators and binomial intervals; a few clean repeats cannot establish a 5% family error bound

experiments.procedure: Inject a preregistered delay or resource cost while preserving correct answers; include no-injection control and independent confirmation
experiments.passEvidence: Observed effect against injected effect, detection counts and uncertainty; record injection location and timing boundary

experiments.procedure: Calibrate equivalent response sizes/costs against a controlled endpoint; repeat the target load with increased independent driver resources
experiments.passEvidence: Achieved schedule, queue/late/drop counts, driver CPU/RSS/network; saturation conclusion requires demonstrated driver headroom

experiments.procedure: Paired collector-on/off runs with identical validation and load policies
experiments.passEvidence: Overhead estimates and uncertainty within preregistered budget; missing counters disclosed

experiments.procedure: Unit/contract injection of wrong IDs, missing/duplicate/reordered rows, truncated responses, timeout, unknown commits and corrupted artifacts
experiments.passEvidence: No false valid score; bounded failure diagnostics; no incomplete-run merging

experiments.procedure: Second contributor or independently provisioned environment follows the frozen package; rebuild and reproduce correctness and analysis from evidence
experiments.passEvidence: Commands, environment and artifact identities, observed differences and independent sign-off

budgetFormula: sum over experiments and cells of runs * (restore + warmup + measurement + drain), plus asset capture/import/reference generation
resourceEstimateStatus: SF100 byte sizes and actual HStore footprint are not established; do not promise a fit on the supplied 152 GiB-free host
remoteConstraint: Long-running or resource-heavy jobs require explicit user confirmation before execution
